validation.devBrowserCheck: passed on /home-v4-3 at 1440x900, 800x609 and 375x812: single visible h1, hero height = viewport, quote modal opens and closes with Escape, stage selection flies the camera, navbar tone flips correctly, no console errors
validation.scrollCheck: passed at 1440x900: section stays pinned (top 0) through the 2880px run, stages advance in order, h1 visible throughout, clip-path none, pill click scrolls to stage; 375x812 stays 812px tall with Fly through; no console errors

heroReplacement.scrollDrivenStages: desktop: pinned 420svh runway like the section variant; scroll advances overview -> power, stage pills scroll to their stage, "Scroll or pick a stage" hint on load. Mobile, reduced motion and capture: single 100svh free mode with Fly through

depthLayer.component: source/components/PlantDepth.tsx (unchanged from the zip; imports framer-motion)
depthLayer.integration: usePlantDepth reads the existing x / y / cameraScale; canvas div uses depth.camX/camY/camScale; PlantDepthCanvas is the first child of the Stage div (outside the CSS-scaled canvas); flat next/image (plant-4096.jpg) shows until WebGL reports ready and stays when WebGL2 is unavailable; markers moved into PlantMarker with useDepthShift; fog follows the depth camera; PlantNode gains depth (values from INTEGRATION.md)
depthLayer.markerCentering: marker centring moved from Tailwind -translate-1/2 classes (overwritten by the motion transform) to motion x/y -50% on an inner button, with the depth shift on an outer anchor
depthLayer.propsAdded: depth3d?: PlantDepthSources | false (defaults to PLANT_DEPTH_SOURCES); imageSrc default -> /images/plant/plant-4096.jpg; imageAspect default -> 6000/3376
depthLayer.reducedMotion: enabled=false when reduced motion or capture mode (no hover, breathe, sway or parallax); WebGL still draws a still frame
depthLayer.validation: tsc passed; dev browser: WebGL2 active, desktop loads plant-6000.webp + depth.png, 375x812 loads plant-4096.jpg + depth.png, flat image unmounts once ready, idle hover changes the camera transform, markers centred on anchors, kiln zoom sharp, no console errors. OS reduced-motion not toggled in the browser check

edgeStageAutoZoom.problem: the no-edge camera clamp stopped edge stages short of the focal anchor (1366x768: crusher -259px, packing +350px, power +262px), leaving them under the HUD
edgeStageAutoZoom.fix: per stage s = min(max(authored scale, smallest scale that lets the focal point reach the anchor under the PULL_SAFETY clamp), SOURCE_PX_WIDTH * MAX_UPSCALE / canvasW)

predicted.1366x768: crusher 3.23, packing 3.43, power 2.48: all on anchor
predicted.1440x900: crusher 2.91, packing 3.09, power 2.24: all on anchor
predicted.1920x1080: crusher and packing capped at 2.60 (171/249px short, in the clear area); power on anchor

edgeStageAutoZoom.validation: tsc passed; geometry model reproduces the reported crusher position (predicted x~369 vs screenshot ~358 at 1366x768). In-browser check pending: the Browser pane was hidden, which pauses requestAnimationFrame
